I am sorry to say but your map, Colors, has been denied from testing for the Avicus Network.


To Improve your map, the map developers suggest that you change the block pallet a bit and expand the frontlines to prevent stalemating.

If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, message me on Skype (downfallgaming123)

You may resubmit your map once edited.
